title: Sources: NYT has entered exclusive negotiations to acquire Letterboxd for roughly $330M; A24 dropped out of negotiations after price expectations rose (New York Times)
summary: New York Times: Sources: NYT has entered exclusive negotiations to acquire Letterboxd for roughly $330M; A24 dropped out of negotiations after price expectations rose — The roughly $330 million deal for the cinephile community site would be part of an effort to add new products and services to the company's portfolio.
